'''2016 MPC Steve Harpster LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Harpster]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
